HOW TO READ THIS PASTE
Files 06, 07 and 11 are histogram bins (bin_left, bin_right, count), not the raw 50,000 rows. Draw the bar from the midpoint of each bin with height = count.
File 13 is every 10th ball of Jos Buttler's batting rating, plus the last ball of each match. ball_seq_number is the career ball.
Band cutoffs are the p50 and p80 in file 08. They are the cuts the model used.
High band vs clutch correlation: batters 0.147 (n=223), bowlers 0.417 (n=232).
Sample innings: IPL 2025 final, 2025-06-03, Royal Challengers Bengaluru vs Punjab Kings, innings 2.
Buttler rating rise: 2026-07-11 England vs India, 131 runs, match_id 45394.
Buttler rating fall: 2023-04-19 Rajasthan Royals vs Lucknow Super Giants, 36 runs, match_id 20206.
Acceptance lines for Elo: min 600, max 2800, std 250.
Component bars in file 21 are already weight times z-score, so they sum to the composite.
